title: 2012 RUSSIAN MEDALLION
findings: Not a plain Russian medallion: an antiqued-finish coin in capsule, 'MOSCOW KREMLIN' 2012, St Basil's and Kremlin architecture in high relief with an inset red translucent window panel. Matches the CIT/Palau-type 2012 architecture series silver coins with glass or stone inlay (likely around 2 oz .999 silver, limited mintage). Only one side shown so issuer, denomination and metal not confirmed; copies exist.
condition: In capsule, inlay looks intact, light surface marks on inlay.
reason: Appears to be a 2012 Moscow Kremlin antiqued silver coin with inlay, mis-described as a medallion; such issues sell well over bullion.
